_comment_for_adopters: Reference shape only. Replace example commands with your own scripts. Hooks should READ memory-bank context, not WRITE to it. See docs/integration-architecture.md and docs/automation-patterns.md. Verify hook field names against https://geminicli.com/docs/hooks/ before customising — Gemini may evolve the schema.

SessionStart._comment: Pre-load memory-bank essentials: brief.md plus any tasks/work/*.md whose branch: matches the current git branch. Adopters supply the script. stdout is prepended/injected as context for the session.

BeforeTool._comment: Before any tool call, gate dangerous operations or apply project-specific policy. Replace with whatever you want to gate (e.g. block writes outside memory-bank/tasks/, refuse destructive git operations, etc.).

AfterTool._comment: Optional: after edits to source code, trigger a fast lint or type-check. Keep it fast — this runs after every tool call.

mcpServers._comment: Declare MCP servers here if your project uses any. Example DMB MCP server slot (if/when DMB ships one — see docs/integration-architecture.md):

context._comment: Optional: override the default GEMINI.md filename if your project uses a different convention.
